name: Slatemark
description:
Slatemark connects Claude to the record you keep around each journaled trade: delayed market data and analytics, public and primary-source research, your trade journal and framework rules, and, on Plus, authorized brokerage Account Data. Market data is approximately 15 minutes delayed and labeled with its freshness. On Plus, option-chain snapshots are available where listed. They contain no Greeks and use indicative, non-executable midpoint marks. Brokerage connections provide synced account views of balances, positions, orders, and activity, not market data. Upstream results include source and fetch-time metadata.

Use it to compare facts with your recorded rules, keep your thesis beside the outcome, and review patterns across past closed trades. On Plus, available brokerage fills can be imported and reconciled periodically while manual and broker-derived facts remain distinct. The Strategy Scorecard describes your own closed-trade results. It does not forecast them.

Claude creates each response. Slatemark hosts no model. Market, research, and brokerage access are read-only. Journal tools can change only your Slatemark records. Slatemark cannot place, modify, or cancel orders, move money, change a brokerage account, or tell you what to trade. It does not provide investment advice and is not a registered investment adviser, broker-dealer, financial planner, or fiduciary. This listing installs only the connector. The optional senior-analyst skill is separate.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Slatemark to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Slatemark to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://slatemark.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Slatemark MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Slatemark lists 87 MCP tools, including analyze_beta, analyze_correlation, analyze_credit_quality_curve, analyze_credit_term_structure, analyze_journal_patterns, analyze_kelly_sizing, analyze_macro_regime, analyze_market_regime, analyze_option_chain, analyze_pair_spread, analyze_portfolio_concentration, and analyze_portfolio_factor_exposure.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Slatemark?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Slatemark in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Slatemark requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Slatemark is developed by PD&A LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
